limits: Retrieval uses a boolean lexical match, not semantic embeddings or RAG quality proof.
Tenant filters are an in-memory contract model, not DB RLS proof.
Rich text supports only synthetic paragraph runs/bold/italic; no IME/paste/selection mapping/editor engine proof.
Undo is snapshot-based single writer, not collaborative selective undo.
Shared renderer check verifies a deliberately small semantic output only.
No OCR/PDF/audio/video extraction, Google/YouTube/Drive API or paid calls.
